description: This file defines enums, structs, and functions related to string escaping mechanisms used in build scripts, including platform-specific escaping options and various escaping modes.

methods.name: EscapeString
methods.description: Escapes the given input string according to specified options, returning the escaped string.

methods.name: EscapeStringToStream
methods.description: Writes the escaped version of the input string to the provided output stream.

methods.name: EscapeJSONStringToStream
methods.description: Escapes the input string for JSON and writes it to the output stream.
